observations: Photo 0: Black Nikon DSLR body with lens attached, resting on a white McSteve Gadget Store box; "Nikon" on pentaprism; model text visible on front near lens mount; lens shows "Nikon AF-P"
Photo 1: Camera from rear three-quarter view; lens barrel clearly reads "70-300mm"; mode dial and controls visible; same McSteve box
Photo 2: Side view showing scuffing and wear on the camera grip and body; "Nikon" on pentaprism; lens attached

claims.evidence: photo 0 shows Nikon branding and D3400 model text on body

claims.claim: working perfectly ok with no fault
claims.evidence: photos cannot demonstrate camera or lens function

risks.risk: Camera body may not power on, or shutter/sensor may be faulty
risks.proof: video of camera turning on, taking a photo, and reviewing the image

risks.risk: Lens may have fungus, haze, separation, or autofocus failure
risks.proof: close-up photos of front and rear lens elements, plus video of autofocus operation

risks.risk: Shutter count may be high or near end of rated life
risks.proof: screenshot of shutter count from camera menu or EXIF data from a sample photo

risks.risk: Battery, charger, strap, or lens caps may be missing or damaged
risks.proof: photo of all accessories included in the sale

proof_requests: Video of camera powering on, taking a photo, and reviewing it
Close-up photos of lens front and rear glass
Screenshot of shutter count or camera menu settings
Photo of battery, charger, strap, and caps
response.reason: The Nikon D3400 with 70-300mm lens is identifiable from the photos; the working condition is unverified so it is priced at its worst case.
